title: Signature-Kernel Based Evaluation Metrics for Robust Probabilistic and Tail-Event Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2602.10182v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Standard sample-based metrics like Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) and Quantile Loss (QL) are frequently used in the evaluation of probabilistic time-series forecasting. However, these metrics fail to capture multivariate correlations or assess the ability to capture distribution tails. These global metrics are insensitive to errors on high-utility events in distributional tails due to over-representation of the distribution's body. To accurately measure distributional fidelity on tail-regions and regions of high utility while still having a proper scoring rule, we introduce a family of censored signature kernel metrics. Our proposed metrics concentrate evaluation of forecasts to a focus region, representing high-utility or distributional tails, by collapsing the body of the distribution to a single pivot. translated_title: 基于签名核的鲁棒概率预测与尾部事件预测评估指标
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.10182v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：连续分级概率评分（CRPS）和分位数损失（QL）等标准的基于样本的度量指标被广泛用于概率时间序列预测的评估。然而，这些指标无法捕捉多变量之间的相关性，也无法评估模型捕捉分布尾部的能力。由于分布的主体部分在指标中被过度代表，这些全局指标对分布尾部中高效用事件上的误差不敏感。为了在保持适当评分规则特性的同时，准确衡量分布尾部区域和高效用区域上的分布保真度，我们提出了一族删失签名核度量指标。我们提出的指标通过将分布的主体收缩为单一枢轴点，将预测评估集中于关注区域，即代表高效用或分布尾部的区域。我们在时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）上的基准测试表明，虽然可以为分布形成明确的排名……
tldr: 本文提出了一族基于签名核的删失评估指标，通过将分布主体收缩为单一枢轴点来聚焦尾部区域和高效用区域的评估，从而更准确地衡量概率预测在分布尾部的保真度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a family of censored signature kernel evaluation metrics that collapse the distribution body to a single pivot, concentrating assessment on tail and high-utility regions to more accurately measure distributional fidelity in probabilistic forecasting.
